method.advance: The assisted-only measured-context arm must add at least three useful works across both generators versus the current measured context, lose at most one existing useful work, and add at most one ordinary flagged work. No confidence or serving changes.
method.alternates: Choose the unique highest context per view. Require strictly above its selection-only ordinary-group order statistic matching the incumbent number of ordinary groups flagged. Tied boundary values abstain.
method.current: First six native contexts whose current raw response is at least 0.50, in source order.
method.held: All Wellcome and Gates held groups, measured as single files. Both actual ordinary body versions and admitted local rewrites.
method.outcome: Useful measured context requires 0.30 non-whitespace IoU and 0.50 recall. Report exact winning focus and incorrect locations separately.
method.responses: Current 1-human, assisted=edited+humanized, and assisted log odds minus the median assisted log odds of the exact native contexts in that same file.
method.selection: First 16 technical blog groups by SHA-256 of the retained group ID. Only ordinary before/after views set the points.
